title: Vancouver Dark Table: Unique Blind Dining Experience
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Valentine's day is separate menu and drinks.

PLEASE IT IS MUST to make A RESERVATION AT our site on indicated on your ticket for the day and time. We meet customers at this location, 2611 W 4th Ave, Vancouver. Our Hostesses will welcome you, showing you our amazing menu in the Patio before they get seated by visually impaired servers in 100% darkness dining room.
The guests should notify the hostess upon arrival of any food allergy or restrictions
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Culinary adventure awaits at Dark Table, Vancouver’s premier blind dining restaurant. Immerse yourself in complete darkness, where your taste buds will take center stage as you savor dishes expertly crafted from a first class menu. guided by visually impaired servers, this unique experience challenges your perception of food, elevating taste, smell. As you navigate your meal in pitch black, prepare for a deeper connections with your dining companions while creating unforgettable memories. Dark Table promises a dining experience that is not only innovative but also supports the empowerment of the blind community Dark Table offers a unique dining experience focused mainly on Italian and Canadian cuisine. We are fully licensed and serve excellent cocktails, which can be enjoyed as a surprise or chosen from your menu. We also offer a good selection of wines, champagne, and a variety of spirits. At Dark Table, we promise more than just a meal. We promise an amazing and memorable experience.
